root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The immediate cleanup after `zip_source_crc_create(src_window, 1, NULL)` must not free `src_window` while `src_crc->src` still aliases it.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the post-CRC cleanup point, the object chosen as the immediate `zip_source_free()` argument must already be different from the lower-layer pointer retained in `src_crc->src` before `zip_source_open(src_crc)` is allowed to execute.
root_cause_criterion.description: In the vulnerable run, the post-CRC cleanup still chooses `src_window` as the immediate free argument while `src_crc->src` is that same pointer, so the lower layer is destroyed before the wrapper is opened. In the fixed program, there is no immediate free at that point, so the retained lower layer stays live when the later recursive `zip_source_open()` sink executes.

nodes.state: The recursive `zip_source_open()` frame that receives the tracked lower-layer pointer reaches the `src->source_closed` read, which is the AddressSanitizer-reported heap-use-after-free sink.

edges.relation: The exact `src_window` pointer released by the immediate post-CRC `zip_source_free()` call is later reused as the `src` argument of the recursive `zip_source_open()` frame that performs the `src->source_closed` sink read.
